description: Defines the 'pucch_info' structure which contains information about PUCCH resources used in scheduling, including format, configuration, and context.

classes.name: pucch_info
classes.description: Contains information about a PUCCH resource used in scheduling, including format, configuration, and context.

classes.name: pucch_info::context
classes.description: Holds context-specific data for a PUCCH PDU, such as ID and whether it uses common resources.

methods.name: pucch_info::format
methods.description: Returns the format of the PUCCH based on the variant stored in 'format_params'.

methods.name: pucch_info::set_format
methods.description: Sets the format parameters for the PUCCH based on the specified format.
